# Fiveable

> > Fiveable is a comprehensive educational platform providing study guides, key terms, vocabulary references, and AP exam preparation tools across humanities, sciences, and social studies.

Fiveable offers structured learning resources for high school and college students, featuring detailed glossaries, practice tools, and score calculators aligned with College Board AP curricula. The platform covers subjects ranging from AP courses to specialized topics like ancient history, literature, and scientific disciplines.

## Key Topics

- AP Exam Preparation
- College Board
- Key Terms & Vocabulary
- Study Guides
- AP Score Calculators
- Medical Terminology
- Ancient Mediterranean History
- Computer Science Principles
- Chemistry & Physics
- Macroeconomics
- African American Literature
- Historical Terms
- Educational Content
- Exam Prediction Tools

## AP Course Vocabulary & Key Terms

- [AP Computer Science Principles Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/ap-comp-sci-p/key-terms): AP CS Principles vocabulary with algorithms, API & programming concepts
- [AP Chemistry Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/ap-chem/key-terms): AP Chemistry vocabulary: VSEPR, Lewis Diagrams & Beer-Lambert Law
- [AP Macroeconomics Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/ap-macro/key-terms): AP Macro vocabulary: GDP, PPC & Aggregate Demand-Supply models
- [AP Italian Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/ap-italian/key-terms): AP Italian vocabulary covering Mussolini, Bernini & Renaissance figures

## AP Exam Tools & Calculators

- [AP Physics 2 AP Score Calculator 2026](https://fiveable.me/ap-physics-2-revised/ap-score-calculator): AP Physics 2 score calculator using College Board rubric points
- [AP World History: Modern AP Score Calculator 2026](https://fiveable.me/ap-world/ap-score-calculator): AP World History score calculator with DBQ & LEQ rubric scoring
- [AP French Guided Practice](https://fiveable.me/ap-french/guided-practice): Interactive AP French practice tool with progress tracking
- [AP vs IB 2026: Complete Guide](https://fiveable.me/ap-vs-ib): Compare AP vs IB programs: structure, college credit & admissions impact

## Science & Medicine Key Terms

- [Anatomy and Physiology I Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/anatomy-physiology/key-terms): Anatomy & Physiology I vocabulary reference with medical terminology
- [Cell Biology Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/cell-biology/key-terms): Cell Biology glossary with key terms from Ada Yonath research
- [Animal Physiology – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/animal-physiology): Animal Physiology study guides on homeostasis & nervous systems
- [Biophysical Chemistry – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/biophysical-chemistry): Biophysical Chemistry guides on thermodynamics & enzyme kinetics

## History & Humanities Study Guides

- [Ancient Mediterranean Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/ancient-mediterranean/key-terms): Ancient Mediterranean glossary covering dynasties & Achaemenid Empire
- [History of Africa – 1800 to Present - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/africa-since-1800): African history guides covering colonialism, decolonization & Pan-Africanism
- [Ancient History and Myth - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/ancient-times-myth-history-measurement): Ancient history & mythology guides: Mesopotamia, Egypt & Greek myths
- [African American Literature – 1900 to Present - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/african-american-literature-since-1900): African American lit guides: Hughes, Hurston, Wright & Harlem Renaissance

## Specialized Subject Areas

- [Civil Procedure Key Terms & Vocabulary](https://fiveable.me/civil-procedure/key-terms): Civil Procedure legal definitions covering federal jurisdiction statutes
- [Business Analytics – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/business-analytics): Business Analytics guides covering data analysis & predictive analytics
- [Art Therapy – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/art-therapy): Art Therapy study guides covering Lowenfeld & therapeutic techniques
